sites.scrape_prompt: Extract every upcoming event shown on this page. Return only a JSON array with no markdown or explanation. Each item must have exactly these string keys: Show, Date(s), and Description. Preserve each displayed title and date range exactly. Include every event card even when its description is blank. Set Description to an empty string when the page does not provide one. Do not emit NA as a placeholder. Do not include past events, navigation items, or individual performance times as separate shows.
